title: Tickeron Launches Semi-AI Trading Robot: 228% Annualized Return for Retail Traders (POET)
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
# Key Takeaways

* Tickeron has launched a new **Semi-AI Trading Robot** focused on **POET Technologies (**[**POET**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/POET/)**)** and **Satellogic Inc. (**[**SATL**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SATL/)**)**.
* The 60-minute strategy delivered an **annualized return of 260.38%** over a **362-day** evaluation period.
* Enhanced **Financial Learning Models (FLMs)** now power faster **15-minute** and **5-minute** [AI Trading Agents](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/).
* AI infrastructure, semiconductors, photonics, and space technology continue to present active momentum trading opportunities.

# New Semi-AI Trading Robot Targets [POET](https://tickeron.com/ticker/POET/) and SATL

[Tickeron](https://tickeron.com/) has introduced a new **Semi-AI Trading Robot** designed to provide retail traders with a systematic approach to trading **POET Technologies (POET)** and **Satellogic Inc. (SATL)**. Built on the company's proprietary **Financial Learning Models (FLMs)**, the strategy analyzes market data to identify momentum and breakout opportunities using a **60-minute** trading framework.

# Trading Performance

According to Tickeron's published results covering the period from **July 8, 2025, through July 7, 2026**, the strategy generated an **annualized return of 260.38%** based on a model allocation of **$2,500 per trade**.

During the evaluation period, the AI-powered system completed **455 long trades**, demonstrating consistent participation in market opportunities.

Additional performance metrics include:

* **76.70% win rate**
* **Profit Factor:** **2.33**
* **Average trade duration:** **22 hours**
* **Absolute drawdown:** **$3,093.17**

The strategy operates exclusively on the long side, targeting momentum-driven opportunities in companies involved in **AI hardware, photonics, and satellite technology**.

# Faster Financial Learning Models

Tickeron recently upgraded its computing infrastructure, enabling its proprietary **Financial Learning Models (FLMs)** to process market information more efficiently and respond faster to changing market conditions.

These improvements have supported the rollout of new **15-minute** and **5-minute** [**AI Trading Agents**](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/), complementing the platform's existing **60-minute** strategies. By combining machine learning with technical analysis, the models are designed to detect trend continuation, breakout formations, and shifts in market volatility while helping reduce emotional trading decisions.
